code.finding: ASK_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL configures a Discord webhook used only for posting alerts, not for a Discord agent/bot.

workflow: Cross-session SendMessage can be held undelivered when the recipient session runs in a different permission mode; the sender must not report it as delivered or resend.
When messaging is blocked, another session's activity can be read from ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json and its transcript .jsonl under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/.
Machine-wide greps for a name can match the current session's own transcript files, producing false positives that must be filtered out.

The user's second message was cut off ('can it be in…'), leaving the intended location ambiguous.
The message to lio-keep-line-running was held, leaving that session paused on a permission prompt and unable to answer.
